A_tech_house: Upbeat tech house at 124 bpm: punchy four-on-the-floor kick, rolling bassline, bright stabby synth plucks, crisp claps and shuffled hats, feel-good and energetic.
B_afro_amapiano: Afrobeats and amapiano fusion at 112 bpm: bouncy log drum bass, shakers, syncopated percussion, warm marimba and bright piano riff, sunny and catchy.
C_funky_pop: Funky electro-pop at 118 bpm: slap bass, tight disco drums, handclaps, bright funky guitar licks and shiny synth brass hits, playful and confident.
D_phonk_pop: Modern trap-pop with a light phonk flavour at 140 bpm half-time: punchy 808 bass, snappy snare, rolling hi-hats, catchy bell melody, cheeky and bold, not dark.
E_future_bass: Bright future bass and pop at 150 bpm: big sidechained supersaw chords, sparkly plucks, punchy kick and claps, euphoric and uplifting, social-media energy.
